messages:
Priya (Customer Success): Heads-up: Skyline Health's invoice 5102 failed during a scheduled card run this morning. Stripe returned `do_not_honor`. They're on a deployment call and asked if we can take a one-time wire or manual ACH today.

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=5102 customer=SkylineHealth provider=Stripe code=do_not_honor id=pi_6Mz... log="card_decline_do_not_honor"

Nina (Finance): Ok. We typically offer: 1) immediate manual retry (if they want us to attempt card again), 2) Plaid ACH link, or 3) bank wire with confirmation. For this customer, recommend wire to avoid micro-deposit issues; their bank previously blocked verification flows.

Ari (Ops): Note: avoid retrying within 10 minutes of the failed auth. Gateways mark repeated attempts as fraud. If you want me to run a manual retry, I'll schedule it ~15m later.

Ben (Sales): We can hold activation until proof of wire is posted. If they wire today, we can waive the expedited provisioning fee. Let them know.

Priya (Customer Success): Billing contact is finance@skyline.health. They said their bank doesn't support micro-deposits (business savings). They can provide a bank letter or a same-day outgoing wire confirmation screenshot.

Nina (Finance): Wire template below — send over secure channel only.

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Redwood National Trust
ACH Routing: 061000104
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT: RNTBUS33
Reference: INVOICE 5102 / Skyline Health
```

Nina (Finance): Ask them to include the invoice number in payment reference and to forward the bank's outbound confirmation (PDF or SWIFT copy). When we receive that, finance will post a "paid pending settlement" note in QuickBooks and disable auto-reminders.

Priya (Customer Success): Sent the wire template to finance@skyline.health via our secure mail. They replied they'll initiate wire and send the confirmation within the hour.

Ari (Ops): Once confirmation is posted here, I'll trigger provisioning. If for any reason the wire doesn't clear within 24h, we'll revert to the standard retry schedule.

Ben (Sales): Thanks all. Priya — please paste the confirmation screenshot in this thread when you get it and tag ops. :thumbsup:

Priya (Customer Success): Received the SWIFT copy from the customer: shows $8,500 outgoing on 2026-03-23 14:32 UTC, ref SKY-WIRE-77. Forwarded redacted screenshot to this thread.

Nina (Finance): Received. Marking invoice 5102 as paid pending settlement and adding manual payment entry in QuickBooks. Will unhold activation in ~20m unless AR flags an issue.

Ari (Ops): Copy. I'll proceed with environment provisioning once finance marks complete.

Ben (Sales): Great, thanks team. :tada:
